regressions.source: the public getter of the validatorAuction mapping (struct with a trailing bytes member); no source definition in the AST
regressions.issue: The trailing dynamic bytes of the returned struct is now printed as its raw ABI words (offset 160, length, padded data) instead of Array(len=..., data=...). Same change as in c00213.
regressions.rule: When returned data has the head/tail layout of a dynamic bytes value (offset = head size, then length n, then ceil32(n) bytes), print it as Array(len=n, data=...).

improvements: claimFee (96 -> 64 lines): the Merkle pair hashes decode to sha3(_11, t + leaf) / sha3(t + leaf, _11), the revert strings 'Wrong acc proof' and 'transfer failed' decode, logger.logClaimFee(caller, amount) and token.transfer(caller, amount) are named, and dead scratch stores and call buffers are dropped. checkSignatures: two validators[concat(mem[0])] keys print as validators[_505] / validators[_557] (P4 5 -> 3). P6 3 -> 0, P2 7 -> 5.
notes: Diff of 271 lines, read hunk by hunk. validatorAuction and claimFee moved within the text (delete + add hunks). Calls, logs and storage writes are unchanged. claimFee's 'return' 1 -> 0 is the old 'if ok: stop / revert' now printed as 'if not ok: revert'. The 7 source loops are unchanged. claimFee's Merkle loop keeps its variable offset by the leaf (t + sha3(caller, accumFeeAmount)), as in round 1. Not a change, but the same pattern as reported for c00361.
summary: No semantic regression. claimFee's calls, hashes and revert strings are decoded and two concat keys are resolved. One low cosmetic loss: validatorAuction's bytes return is printed as raw words.
